items.title: StyleStream 2.0: Fast and Controllable Streaming Voice Style Conversion
items.title_zh: StyleStream 2.0：快速可控的流式语音风格转换
items.description: Voice style conversion (VSC) aims to transform a source utterance to match the timbre, accent, and emotion of a target voice while preserving linguistic content. StyleStream 1.0 introduced the first streamable zero-shot VSC system with state-of-the-art conversion quality, but remained limited in two ways: approximately 1s end-to-end latency on consumer hardware, and the lack of a text-based interface for designing or editing target voices. We present StyleStream 2.0, a fast and controllable streaming VSC framework that addresses these limitations. To reduce latency, we train a few-step pixel MeanFlow model and further fine-tune it with autoregressive feedback inspired by Self Forcing, improving robustness under streaming inference. This reduces end-to-end latency to 520~ms on a consumer GPU, a 2x speedup over StyleStream 1.0, while maintaining conversion quality. To enable controllable style manipulation, we remove the mel-spectrogram context and instead route target style information through a compact style embedding. In this embedding space, we train a unified text-conditioned flow matching model that supports both text-based voice design, which maps natural language prompts to voice styles, and instruction-based voice editing, which modifies a specific attribute of a source utterance while preserving the rest. Experiments show that StyleStream 2.0 achieves the strongest target style fidelity on VSC, voice design, and voice editing, while remaining competitive on intelligibility and non-edited attribute preservation.
items.description_zh: 语音风格转换 (VSC) 旨在转换源话语以匹配目标语音的音色、口音和情感，同时保留语言内容。 StyleStream 1.0 引入了第一个具有最先进转换质量的流式零样本 VSC 系统，但在两个方面仍然受到限制：消费类硬件上大约 1 秒的端到端延迟，以及缺乏用于设计或编辑目标语音的基于文本的界面。我们推出了 StyleStream 2.0，这是一种快速且可控的流式 VSC 框架，可以解决这些限制。为了减少延迟，我们训练了几个步骤的像素 MeanFlow 模型，并利用受自强迫启发的自回归反馈进一步对其进行微调，从而提高了流推理下的鲁棒性。这将消费级 GPU 上的端到端延迟降低至 520~ms，比 StyleStream 1.0 加速了 2 倍，同时保持了转换质量。为了实现可控的样式操作，我们删除了梅尔谱图上下文，而是通过紧凑的样式嵌入来路由目标样式信息。在这个嵌入空间中，我们训练了一个统一的文本条件流匹配模型，该模型支持基于文本的语音设计（将自然语言提示映射到语音样式）和基于指令的语音编辑（修改源话语的特定属性，同时保留其余部分）。实验表明，StyleStream 2.0 在 VSC、语音设计和语音编辑方面实现了最强的目标风格保真度，同时在清晰度和非编辑属性保留方面保持竞争力。
items.authors: Yisi Liu, Nicholas Lee, Gopala K. Anumanchipalli

items.title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
items.title_zh: FrontierCS 2：计算机科学研发的基准
items.description: Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D? We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks. We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution. The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge returns a development-suite score but keeps the evaluator, the held-out final suite and the reference private, and grades the final submission on that suite against the reference. The tasks span 13 domains, from machine-learning systems and high-performance computing to databases, security and robotics. Beyond these 48 tasks, FrontierCS 2 keeps a private set of more than 100 tasks, to be announced in the future. We evaluate 12 agents. The best one is Claude Opus 5.5, passing 58% of its runs. No run passes on 16 tasks. A higher score is not the same as a pass: most runs that beat the reference on the combined final score still fall short on some metric or workload. On a shared capability scale for agents and tasks, the median task is roughly as difficult as what the strongest agent can handle.
items.description_zh: LLM代理人能否为前沿计算机科学研发做出贡献？我们推出了 FrontierCS 2，它是 48 项开放式任务的基准测试。我们获取一篇论文及其作者发布的代码，并删除该论文的贡献。删除的代码成为设定标准的人类参考。早期的开放式基准测试会在运行后为每个代理提供问题陈述和一级程序。 FrontierCS 2 将代理置于研究环境中。代理继承工作存储库并可以随时提交补丁。对于每个补丁，评委会返回开发套件分数，但将评估者、保留的最终套件和参考保密，并根据参考对该套件的最终提交进行评分。这些任务跨越 13 个领域，从机器学习系统和高性能计算到数据库、安全和机器人技术。除了这 48 项任务之外，FrontierCS 2 还保留了一组包含 100 多项任务的私有任务，这些任务将在未来公布。我们评估了 12 名代理商。最好的一款是 Claude Opus 5.5，通过率��到 58%。没有运行传递 16 个任务。较高的分数并不等于通过：大多数在综合最终分数上超过参考值的运行在某些指标或工作负载上仍然达不到要求。在代理和任务的共享能力范围内，中等任务的难度大致与最强代理可以处理的任务一样困难。

items.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
items.title_zh: 语言模型 学习改进语言模型
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate AI research, including language-model (LM) development, offering a potential path toward recursive self-improvement. However, turning experimental feedback into a learned ability to propose effective improvements across models faces two challenges. First, training such an ability with real feedback is expensive: reinforcement learning (RL) requires evaluating tens of thousands of proposals, each potentially requiring a full model-training run. Even at ten GPU-hours per run, reward collection alone would consume hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours, motivating a cheaper surrogate. Second, surrogate feedback can become unreliable as policy optimization favors overestimated proposals when the proposal distribution shifts. To address these challenges, we propose LM2LM, which trains LLMs with RL to generate effective LM improvement proposals. To provide scalable feedback, we use a research world model (RWM), a frozen LLM that predicts proposal gains from real experimental records provided in context, as the reward model for RL. To maintain feedback reliability, we periodically execute current-policy proposals ranked highly by the RWM and add their measured outcomes to its context. Across eight autoregressive and diffusion LM development environments, real-execution evaluations on held-out tasks show that LM2LM enables Qwen3.8-27B to outperform GPT-6-sol, even when GPT-6-sol is given 300 real experimental records in context, while requiring 33% lower data-generation cost. LM2LM also generalizes to a model family unseen during training.
items.description_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地用于自动化人工智能研究，包括语言模型 (LM) 开发，为递归自我改进提供了潜在的途径。然而，将实验反馈转化为一种学习能力以提出跨模型的有效改进面临着两个挑战。首先，利用真实反馈来训练这种能力的成本很高：强化学习 (RL) 需要评估数以万计的建议，每个建议都可能需要完整的模型训练运行。即使每次运行需要 10 个 GPU 小时，仅奖励收集就会消耗数十万个 GPU 小时，从而激励更便宜的代理。其次，当提案分布发生变化时，由于政策优化倾向于高估的提案，因此替代反馈可能会变得不可靠。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LM2LM，它使用 RL 来训练LLM，以生成有效的 LM 改进建议。为了提供可扩展的反馈，我们使用研究世界模型（RWM），这是一种冻结的LLM，可以从上下文中提供的真实实验记录中预测提案收益，作为强化学习的奖励模型。为了保持反馈的可靠性，我们定期执行 RWM 排名较高的当前政策提案，并将其衡量结果添加到其背景中。在八个自回归和扩散 LM 开发环境中，对保留任务的实际执行评估表明，即使在上下文中为 GPT-6-sol 提供 300 个真实实验记录，LM2LM 也能使 Qwen3.8-27B 的性能优于 GPT-6-sol，同时需要降低 33% 的数据生成成本。 LM2LM 还可以推广到训练期间未见过的模型族。
items.authors: Minhua Lin, Zijun Wang, Zewen Liu, Zhaotian Weng, Bing He, Zhan Shi, Benoit Dumoulin, Xiang Zhang, Suhang Wang, Hanqing Lu

items.title: VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: VerifierBench：对 LLM 代理的可执行验证程序的生成进行基准测试
items.description: Agents need reliable ways to validate their outputs, both when completing tasks and when filtering synthetic training data. We study verifier generation: from the instruction and environment available for solving a task, an agent writes an executable verifier that must accept every valid solution and reject invalid ones. We introduce VerifierBench, a benchmark of 222 tasks from six agent benchmarks spanning tool-call, state-based, and code verification, with 4,993 hidden test cases that include alternative valid solutions and attacks; Verifier4Verifier (V4V), a six-check audit, screens its source verifiers and test suites. Across 19 models in a common agent harness, normalized balanced accuracy ranges from 10.6 to 62.1, with generated verifiers consistently rejecting invalid solutions more reliably than they accept valid ones. This apparent strength can mask overly restrictive verification: most false rejections in the analyzed records come from verifiers that accept no tested solution to a task. Case studies reveal unsupported assumptions about solution formats, tool use, and code changes that exclude valid solutions. These errors survive self-testing because agents test solutions that share the verifier's mistaken assumptions, or submit verifiers without confirming that any correct solution passes. These findings suggest testing both whether a verifier accepts a correct solution and whether it accepts other solutions permitted by the task. The project page and dataset are publicly available.
items.description_zh: 代理在完成任务和过滤合成训练数据时都需要可靠的方法来验证其输出。我们研究验证器的生成：根据可用于解决任务的指令和环境，代理编写一个可执行验证器，该验证器必须接受每个有效的解决方案并拒绝无效的解决方案。我们推出了 VerifierBench，这是一个由 6 个代理基准测试中的 222 个任务组成的基准测试，涵盖工具调用、基于状态和代码验证，以及 4,993 个隐藏测试用例，其中包括替代的有效解决方案和攻击； Verifier4Verifier (V4V) 是一项六项检查审核，筛选其源验证器和测试套件。在通用代理工具中的 19 个模型中，标准化平衡精度范围为 10.6 到 62.1，生成的验证器始终拒绝无效解决方案，比接受有效解决方案更可靠。这种明显的优势可能会掩盖过于严格的验证：分析记录中的大多数错误拒绝来自于不接受未经过测试的任务解决方案的验证者。案例研究揭示了有关解决方案格式、工具使用和排除有效解决方案的代码更改的不受支持的假设。这些错误能够在自测试中幸存下来，因为代理测试的解决方案���享验证者的错误假设，或者在未确认任何正确解决方案通过的情况下提交验证者。这些发现建议测试验证者是否接受正确的解决方案以及是否接受任务允许的其他解决方案。项目页面和数据集是公开的。
items.authors: Jianing Yin, Ziyi Chen, Hao Wang, Yiyou Sun, Zijian Jin, Dawn Song, Daoan Zhang

items.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: 循环一致扩散语言模型
items.description: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.
items.description_zh: 统一扩散语言模型（UDLM）通过迭代地对普通词汇标记序列进行去噪来生成文本，其中任何一个都可能被损坏并随后进行修改。在训练期间，UDLM 必须从本身可能不可靠的上下文中进行去噪，而掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 始终以干净的上下文为条件。这种具有挑战性的训练目标使得 UDLM 的训练比 MDLM 更加密集，但它会产生更强的下游推理性能。最近，选择性循环（在每个去噪步骤中递归地应用一些早期 Transformer 层）已被证明可以在 iso-FLOP 预算下提高 MDLM 的训练效率。我们研究 UDLM 中的循环，同时保持训练目标和采样器不变。我们发现循环显着提高了训练效率：循环 UDLM 达到了在约 5 万亿个令牌上训练的非循环 UDLM 的验证 NLL，并且 OpenWebText 上的训练 FLOP 减少了 2.8 倍，FineWeb-Edu 上的训练 FLOP 减少了 3.3 倍。我们还发现，在匹配的 NFE 预算下，循环 UDLM 的生成困惑度比非循环 UDLM 降低了 9.8%，并且大部分增益是在适度的循环计数下实现的。最后，我们研究了不同的循环计数分布，发现在训练期间更频繁地采样较小的循环计数可以提高推理效率：在下游任务中，该策略比统一循环计数采样少使用 12% 的循环，而不会降低准确性。
items.authors: Saiteja Utpala, Chieh-Hsin Lai, Yuki Mitsufuji, Praneeth Vepakomma

items.title: RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation
items.title_zh: RoboCasa-Shift：长视野家庭操纵中视觉-语言-行动策略的阶段感知稳健性评估
items.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) robustness is commonly summarized by aggregate task success, which obscures how individual executions change under distribution shifts and where failures emerge in long-horizon tasks. We introduce RoboCasa-Shift, a diagnostic robustness benchmark built on RoboCasa365 that combines controlled single-factor shifts, matched clean-perturbed rollouts in which each pair shares the same underlying settings and differs only in the target shift, and simulator-grounded stage-aware diagnostics. We evaluate GR00T N1.5 on four long-horizon tasks that pass a predefined clean-performance gate under four perturbation factors and three calibrated severity levels, including conditions that drive the evaluated policy to complete task failure, totaling 1,040 formal rollouts. Robustness responses vary substantially across factors and tasks, and increasing severity does not always produce monotonic degradation. For example, one camera condition yields ΔSR=0 despite 8 of 80 matched episodes changing outcome. Stage-aware analysis further shows that the same end-to-end degradation can correspond to different execution-depth profiles. Camera L_2 and Gaussian blur L_1 both yield ΔSR=0.188, yet their first-stage failure rates are 19.0\% and 36.4\%, respectively. Our findings suggest that VLA robustness should be viewed as a multi-dimensional property of execution rather than a single end-to-end performance measure, motivating evaluation protocols that jointly capture outcome degradation, paired outcome sensitivity, and failure progression. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaochengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift.
items.description_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）稳健性通常用总体任务成功来概括，这掩盖了个体执行在分布变化下如何变化以及长期任务中出现失败的地方。我们推出了 RoboCasa-Shift，这是一个基于 RoboCasa365 构建的诊断鲁棒性基准，它结合了受控的单因素转变、匹配的干净扰动推出（其中每对共享相同的基础设置，仅目标转变不同）以及基于模拟器的阶段感知诊断。我们在四个长期任务上评估 GR00T N1.5，这些任务在四个扰动因素和三个校准严重性级别下通过了预定义的清洁性能门，包括驱动评估策略完成任务失败的条件，总共 1,040 次正式部署。鲁棒性响应因因素和任务的不同而有很大差异，并且严重性的增加并不总是会产生单调退化。例如，尽管 80 个匹配的片段中有 8 个改变了结果，但一种摄像机条件会产生 ΔSR=0。阶段感知分析进一步表明，相同的端到端降级可以对应于不同的执行深度配置文件。相机L_2和高斯模糊L_1的ΔSR=0.188，但它们的第一阶段故障率分别为19.0%和36.4%。我们的研究结果表明，VLA 稳健性应被视为执行的多维属性，而不是单一的端到端绩效衡量标准，从而激发联合捕获结果退化、配对结果敏感性和失败进展的评估协议。该代码可在 https://github.com/Hao ChengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift 上公开获取。
items.authors: Haocheng Wang, Youquan Liu, Weiyu Guo, Aokai Zhang, Donghang Wu, Hongyu Liu, Sha Zhang, Weidong Yang, Ben Fei

items.title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
items.title_zh: 探索合成数据的实证隐私景观
items.description: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information. In this paper, we present a controlled comparison of data-level and training-level interventions for navigating the capability-privacy tradeoff on synthetic medical records with canaries to probe for leakage. Direct finetuning performs best on capability metrics but leads to the most privacy leakage, while DP-SGD reduces leakage at substantial cost to capabilities. Generating synthetic data from these records offers a more favorable balance, particularly when guided by a uniqueness-aware instruction to replace private details. Relative to naive paraphrasing, privacy-aware rewriting improves privacy protection across a variety of different rewriting models. We also find that more capable rewriting models generally reduce the risks of downstream privacy leakage, although held-out fit does not improve monotonically and increased test-time compute yields inconsistent gains. Overall, these results highlight privacy-aware rewriting as a promising direction for achieving a more favorable trade-off between capabilities and empirical privacy compared to other training-level methods, and our evaluation framework supports comparisons of future models and methods.
items.description_zh: 针对敏感数据训练语言模型的方法的不同之处在于如何平衡能力增益与泄露私人信息的风险。在本文中，我们对数据级和培训级干预措施进行了受控比较，以利用金丝雀来探索合成医疗记录的能力与隐私权衡，以探测泄漏。直接微调在能力指标上表现最好，但会导致最多的隐私泄露，而 DP-SGD 则以极大的能力成本为代价来减少泄露。从这些记录生成合成数据提供了更有利的平衡，特别是在唯一性感知指令的指导下替换私人详细信息时。相对于朴素的释义，隐私意识重写可以改善各种不同重写模型的隐私保护。我们还发现，能力更强的重写模型通常会降低下游隐私泄露的风险，尽管保留拟合不会单调改进，并且增加的测试时间计算会产生不一致的收益。总的来说，这些结果凸显了隐私意识重写是一个有前途的方向，与其他训练级别的方法相比，可以在功能和经验隐私之间实现更有利的权衡，并且我们的评估框架支持未来模型和方法的比较。
items.authors: Zihao Zhao, Avi Schwarzschild, Casey Meehan, Katherine Lee, Zhili Feng, Dylan Sam

items.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
items.title_zh: 扩散语言模型代理之间的隐藏消息：潜在通信的因果证据
items.description: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text. We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means. In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory. Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters. Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact. On QASC with the two supporting facts split across agents, matched communication reaches 80.8%, but a wrong-example message lowers accuracy to 46.8%, a content effect of +34.0 points. The surprising result is temporal: one late transfer reaches 87.8%, exceeding four recurrent exchanges by +7.0 points. These experiments provide causal evidence for continuous hidden communication between diffusion-LM agents and show that when information is transferred can matter more than how many times agents exchange it.
items.description_zh: 扩散语言模型通过一系列可修改的连续状态形成答案，但多智能体系统通常会丢弃这些状态，并让智能体仅在解码文本后进行通信。我们询问一个独立的扩散轨迹是否可以将紧凑的隐藏消息传递到另一个扩散轨迹中，最重要的是，接收者是否使用该消息的含义。在隐藏消息中，发送者将其去噪状态压缩为四个带符号的稠密向量；接收者消耗它们，同时保留自己的上下文、画布和轨迹。删除一条消息测试该通道是否重要；用另一个示例中的消息替换它可以测试其内容是否重要。在受控任务中，混乱消除了 Tiny-A2D 上 +63.6 分的优势和 Dream-7B 上 +100.0 分的优势，而有针对性的替换则引导接收者走向替换的事实。在 QASC 上，两个支持事实分散在代理之间，匹配的沟通达到 80.8%，但错误的示例消息将准确性降低到 46.8%，内容效应 +34.0 点。令人惊讶的结果是暂时的：一次延迟转移达到 87.8%，比四次定期交换高出 7.0 个百分点。这些实验为扩散LM代理之间持续隐藏的通信提供了因果证据，并表明信息何时传输比代理交换信息的次数更重要。
items.authors: Alan-Barsag Gazzaev, Alexey Gavrilov, Sergey Muravyov, Ilya Makarov

items.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: DiffResearch：利用扩散语言模型加速深度研究
items.description: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.
items.description_zh: 深度研究系统迭代地计划、收集证据、综合和修改，使端到端延迟成为交互使用的关键瓶颈。几乎所有的生产系统都是建立在自回归（AR）语言模型之上，并在规划和长篇写作中继承从左到右的解码。我们提出了 DiffResearch，这是一个开放的多智能体深度研究框架，它将扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 置于每个阶段的核心，并测量扩散主干如何改变延迟和报告质量。保持代理支架、检索代码、提示和评估固定，我们在开放扩散模型和类似的 AR 模型之间交换主干。在 100 个深度研究台任务中，由于规划和编写数量级减少，扩散主干网的端到端速度大约提高了 6 倍。我们进一步引入了 dFast，这是一种分解模式，可以在生成完成之前读取中间去噪状态并提取子查询，为独立分解提供 1.99 倍的中值加速，而不会损失报告质量。在基准测试的 RACE 评分标准上，dFast 在三种配置中获得了最佳总体得分。最后，在公共系统级排行榜快照中，基于更强的扩散模型构建的实例排名高于几个商业系统。我们根据 Apache-2.0 许可证发布 DiffResearch。
items.authors: Alan-Barsag Gazzaev, Alexey Gavrilov, Mikhail Mozikov, Sergey Muravyov

items.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
items.title_zh: Quant-Arena：量化交易研究 LLM 代理的基准测试
items.description: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
items.description_zh: 定量研究是一个迭代循环：研究人员提出市场假设，将其作为可执行信号实施，在历史数据上进行测试，并决定保留什么。现有的基准对公式、代码或个人交易决策进行评分，而大型语言模型 (LLM) 是否能够完成这个循环并产生在研究期之外有效的策略尚不确定。我们推出Quant-Arena，这是一个对真实A股市场数据进行端到端定量研究的基准和公共排行榜。模型构建特征和股票评分代码，仅接收 2022--2023 年的反馈，并冻结一项策略以在 2024 年密封的年份进行评估。现金账户评估器应用交易限制和成本，包括从模拟订单簿估计的市场影响。分数以实现的超额收益为主，并以信号质量和策略使用的功能多样性为补充。我们评估了九个前沿模型，其中 GPT-6 Astra 得分最高；然而，到 2024 年，没有任何模型能够击败同等权重市场。Quant-Arena 开放接受任何模型或代理工具的提交。
items.authors: Houde Qian, Zheng Jiang, Wenyi Li, Chenxi Xu, Xinjie Lin, Yuzhao Peng, Ruoyu Han, Youjie Zheng, Kaisen Yang, Qinhuai Na, You Fu, Calvin Xiao

items.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
items.title_zh: ToM2Vec：用于多代理协调的连续心理理论令牌
items.description: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.
items.description_zh: 形成准确的心理理论 (ToM) 是多智能体协作成功的关键，并且需要在不确定性下进行推理以捕获多个可能的合作伙伴状态。这在大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理本机的文本表示空间中很难做到，因为大型语言模型代理更容易描述单个合作伙伴状态。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 ToM2Vec，它学习通过连续推理标记的固定预算在丰富的潜在空间中形成抽象的心理理论。在训练过程中，对这些 token 的监督来自于合作伙伴的实际想法，ToM token 经过训练来抽象和匹配。在测试时，ToM 令牌由每个代理生成，并充当该代理的思想和行动的调节器。在涵盖协作、竞争和混合动机设置（Overcooked-AI、多方协商、Decrypto、Hanabi 和 Collab Escape/Capture）的多种环境中，我们评估了 ToM2Vec 支持多智能体交互和协作的能力，发现对基本模型以及各种竞争训练和提示基线的一致改进。我们表明，潜在推理至关重要，当推理以文本形式表达时，性能会下降。此外，我们表明 ToM2Vec 训练可推广到训练时未见过的合作伙伴模型系列，包括专有模型 (GPT-5.4)。在我们的分析中，我们提供的证据表明潜在令牌编码 ToM，而不是特定于任务的信息：ToM2Vec 的令牌提高了代理直接回答有关合作伙伴信念、愿望和下一步行动的问题的能力。
items.authors: Nithin Sivakumaran, Ali Payani, Hyunji Lee, Mohit Bansal, Elias Stengel-Eskin

items.title: Design Anything, Design at Scale
items.title_zh: 设计任何东西，大规模设计
items.description: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. Agents therefore need to preserve and apply this intent across domains and as projects grow. We introduce Design Anything, a graph-based harness that preserves design intent outside the model and binds deliverables to the workflow steps that produce them through an intent-execution graph. A task contract retains constraints and decisions, selected designs become explicit inputs to later generations, and a deterministic controller uses bindings and execution records to check output types and counts, identify outstanding deliverables, and guide subsequent turns. We also introduce DesignAnything-Bench, with 228 tasks across 19 design domains, including 38 project families at scales of 6, 14, and 24 artifacts. With the LLM held fixed, Design Anything satisfies 85.0% and 92.5% of the brief's factual constraints with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High and GPT-5.6 Sol High, respectively, exceeding the strongest same-model baselines by 15.4% and 14.4%. These gains reach 25.1% and 23.0% on 24-artifact tasks. Under each model, Design Anything leads or ties in constraint satisfaction in 18 of 19 domains. Professional designers also prefer its complete deliverable sets over those of same-model baselines in a blind evaluation.
items.description_zh: 随着多模式资源转化为媒体输出，代理人工智能有望在长期内与设计意图保持一致。设计师遵循指定目标、约束和可交付成果的简报，随后的工作建立在早期决策的基础上。最近的工作跨任务重用设计经验，但一个项目内的工件之间的协调仍然具有挑战性。因此，代理需要跨领域并随着项目的发展保留和应用这一意图。我们引入了 Design Anything，这是一种基于图形的工具，可将设计意图保留在模型之外，并将可交付成果绑定到通过意图执行图生成这些成果的工作流程步骤。任务契约保留约束和决策，选定的设计成为后代的显式输入，确定性控制器使用绑定和执行记录来检查输出类型和计数，识别未完成的可交付成果并指导后续回合。我们还推出了 DesignAnything-Bench，其中包含 19 个设计领域的 228 项任务，其中包括 6、14 和 24 个工件规模的 38 个项目系列。在 LLM 保持不变的情况下，Design Anything 使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High 和 GPT-5.6 Sol High 分别满足简报事实约束的 85.0% 和 92.5%，分别超出最强的同模型基线 15.4% 和 14.4%。在 24 个工件的任务上，这些增益达到 25.1% 和 23.0%。在每个模型下，Design Anything 在 19 个领域中的 18 个领域中领先或联系约束满足。与盲目评估中的同型号基线相比，专业设计师也更喜欢其完整的可交付集。
items.authors: Xuchao Ren, Siyuan Feng, Jing Huang, Yanhua Yao, Jing Wang, Lingyu Alina Wang, Anan Chen, Hangjie Yuan, Tao Feng, Qiong Wu, Sai Ma

items.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
items.description: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.
items.description_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）将大型语言模型建立在外部知识的基础上。现代管道结合了嵌入、分块、检索、重新排序、查询增强、上下文压缩和代理验证，但这些技术通常一次评估一项。目前尚不清楚它们的孤立收益是否能够在组合中幸存下来，检索质量和答案忠实度是否有利于相同的设计选择，以及小语料库的结论是否适用于大规模。我们预先声明了三个假设并引入了 LASAGNA，这是一种用于受控 RAG 评估的开源框架。我们在 8 个基准测试和从 5K 到 200K 文档的语料库中测试了 450 种配置。出现了三个发现。首先，来自 RAG 管道不同阶段的单独强大技术不一定组合在一起：三种检索技术预测组合改进 +47%，但一起使用时仅实现 +17%。其次，为了检索和忠实度，组件增益的叠加方式不同，优化其中一个可能会损害另一个。第三，最佳组合会随着语料库的增长而变化：在小语料库上获胜的组合可能不会在大规模上保持最佳状态。这些发现表明，单独测量的增益并不能可靠地预测实际性能，并且新的 RAG 技术应使用完整的周围堆栈进行测试。我们呼吁研究人员这样做并提供烤宽面条来简化这些实验。
items.authors: Ido Levy, Segev Shlomov, Leshem Choshen

items.title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
items.title_zh: 从强化学习论文到框架代码：七个开源训练框架的纳入和审查
items.description: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We measure how often this happens. We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026. Of 1,598 papers that propose a general RL training method, 37 reached at least one framework. Across five quarterly cohorts of papers, the number included within 180 days stayed between 5 and 7 while the cohorts grew from 72 to 386 papers. Compared with papers from the same quarters, included papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more, at 41 against 10 percent, and more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, at 29 against 9 percent. Both gaps hold without papers from the companies that maintain the frameworks, while code release was equally common in both groups. The frameworks' issues and pull requests show that few methods are turned away in public. More than nine in ten of the general methods no framework included have no thread there that cites or names them, and many proposals that do appear stay open without a reply. Two further records, the frameworks' issues and the technical reports of 13 large open-weight models, show that users rarely report training failures in public and that the reports state 8 of the 13 widely included methods. We release the data as a tracker that links training failures to framework implementations and lists each framework's contribution rules and earlier proposals.
items.description_zh: 从业者通过训练框架对语言模型使用强化学习方法，因此框架包含的方法对其用户来说只需进行一次配置更改即可。我们测量这种情况发生的频率。我们通过提交历史追踪了 7 个用于 RL 后训练的开源框架，并将它们与 2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间筛选的 6,939 篇 arXiv 论文联系起来。在提出通用 RL 训练方法的 1,598 篇论文中，有 37 篇至少达到了一个框架。在五个季度的论文队列中，180 天内收录的论文数量保持在 5 到 7 篇之间，而队列数量从 72 篇增加到 386 篇。与同一季度的论文相比，包含更频繁地训练 30B 个参数或更多参数的策略的论文（占 41 例，占 10%），并且更频繁地更改现有损失中的系数、剪辑、掩模或权重，占 29 例，占 9%。这两个差距在没有维护框架的公司的论文的情况下仍然存在，而代码发布在这两个群体中同样常见。框架的问题和拉取请求表明，很少有方法被公开拒绝。没有框架包含的通用方法中，超过十分之九没有引用或命名它们的线程，并且许多确实出现的提案仍然处于开放状态，没有得到回复。另外两项记录，即框架问题和 13 个大型开放权重模型的技术报告，表明用户很少公开报告训练失败，并且报告指出了 13 种广泛包含的方法中的 8 种。我们将数据作为跟踪器发布，将训练失败与框架实现联系起来，并列出每个框架的贡献规则和早期提案。

items.title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
items.title_zh: WorldStream：具有分层规划和持久状态的流式传输交互式 3D 世界
items.description: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.
items.description_zh: 我们展示了 WorldStream，一个开放式 3D 世界模型，具有三种同时功能：它将可玩地形扩展到任何预先指定的地图之外，在运行世界中作用于开放式语言，并通过编辑恢复访问过的地点。基于类型化决策模型的分层规划器发出结构化决策状态：宏观修复一组图块上的沉降、生态、交通和水文结构； Micro 专注于在测量地形和接受的邻居承诺下契约到瓦片语义。确定性的地方代码将接受的计划编译为地形、道路、定居点、植被和实体。流媒体将它们的范围分开：计划沿着预测的走廊向前运行，仅在运动很快需要它的地方进行编译，用户身后的几何图形被释放。一项世界纪录保留计划、种子、对象身份和可变状态、边界承诺以及按属性进行的编辑，并随着用户的前进和编辑进行修改；返回的tile会从中重新编译。相同的记录基于交互：模型作用于现有实体，包括有状态的 NPC，它们会在行为时更新、编辑当前区域或将意图附加到未规划的区域。它们共同产生了一个在有​​限预算下扩展的世界，通过独立规划的图块连接起来，并且是交互式的。
items.authors: Xiaoxiao Ma, Weiyang Jin, Yanwen Ma, Haoran Li, Zhixiang Wei, Songchun Zhang, Yaowei Li, Junhao Zhuang, Zeyue Xue, Yuming Li, Zheming Fu, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Feng Zhao
